name: compile-err
about: Measures what the game does when an enabled mod's script no longer compiles (a game update renaming a function a mod calls): gamelab-compile-err calls a function that does not exist. "compile_error": the runner expects the compile to fail, shoots what the player sees 8 s after the menu level starts, records the errors and whether the game is still running, then kills it (no script runs, so it never answers WM_CLOSE).
